raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misstated the electron’s mass (~9.11e-27 kg instead of ~9.11e-31 kg), leading to the incorrect conclusion that the proton is least massive; the electron actually has the least mass.
